name: Audio Player
description: Show and play a signal from Auralise, an impulse response (e.g. the ir output of Deconstruct IR Graph), an audio file, or a Source's sound file: a lane per channel (the body grows with the channels), with a Play/Pause button, Stop, Norm (scale the signal to full level; off by default, so auralisations play at their rendered level), a click in the waveform to seek, and a volume slider. Drag the corner to set the width and the lanes' height. A file plays whole, without pause or seek.

inputParameters.name: audio
inputParameters.description: Audio signal (from Auralise), impulse response (from Deconstruct IR Graph; turn Norm on to hear a quiet one at full level), audio file path, or Source object.
